items.summary: November 19, 2026 - The PostgreSQL Global Development Group today announced the release of PostgreSQL 19, the latest version of the world's most advanced open source database.
items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released!

items.summary: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group has released an update to all supported versions of PostgreSQL, including 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25, as well as the second release candidate of PostgreSQL 19.
items.title: PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, 14.25, and 19 RC 2 Released!
